facts.profile-throne: The king sits on the throne in profile, looking to the left.
facts.flowering-wand: In his right hand he holds a leafy wand upright.
facts.flame-crown: He wears a gold crown with flame-shaped points rising from it.
facts.throne-lions: Black lions and salamander patterns are carved on the back of the throne.
facts.lizard: At the right by his feet is one small black salamander.
facts.robes: Over an orange garment he wears a cloak with a green collar and a salamander pattern.

glosses.lizard: The salamander, said to live even in fire; the strength to handle passion to the end.
glosses.profile-throne: A gaze that looks to the future more than to the present.
glosses.flowering-wand: A leader holding a plan that is still growing.

reversedGloss.excess: Decisiveness turns into arbitrariness and haste.
reversedGloss.waning: The strength to lead and the conviction weaken, and the burden grows.
